definition: Replay existing 1000 Born states per process, fixed/damped starts, 300 repetitions; recovered historical settings; PDF13 primary and PDF15 control.
intentional_differences: Physical backward pdfMode=0 versus forward archive mode
External Born process and per-event starts retained; pTmaxMatch=1 enforces them
Beams production-scale flags stay on to read identical commonQ starts; historical dummy generator uses internal starts
QED off: dedicated historical ISR Sudakov routine trials QCD only
Hadronization, MPI and primordial kT disabled; first QCD emission observable
Pythia8.313 version explicitly authorized; historical generation executable unrecorded

internal_ISR_cutoff.method: Independent arithmetic using the common historical/current AlphaStrong one-loop formulas, MZ=91.188, alphaS(MZ)=.130, thresholds mb=4.8,mc=1.5. Both SpaceShower versions have LAMBDA3MARGIN=1.1. At pT0=0, pTmin=max(configured,1.1*Lambda3).
internal_ISR_cutoff.interpretation: This common automatic infrared floor is not a mismatch. It is below every analysis cutoff.

pdf15_error_qualification: Logged xPDF=0 errors are retained and counted, never silently discarded. The source invokes this heavy-threshold routine only below sqrt(2)*mQ, bounded by6.7883GeV for bottom and1.6971GeV for charm in this setup. Values atlowercuts remainqualified; all events succeed. The primary PDF13 results must contain no Error/Abort diagnostics.
